plugins.name: altoindex
plugins.description: Work with your Apple Notes, Apple Reminders, Apple Calendar, iMessage, Safari, Apple Contacts, Voice Memos, and Granola data synced by alto.index. Includes native app deep links back to every item.

plugins.name: tinydot
plugins.description: Draft, edit, review, import, and publish content on tinydot sites through natural conversation. Import external websites, work with tinydot markdown, wikilinks, embeds, frontmatter, and site customization.

plugins.name: superclock
plugins.description: Real alarms on your iPhone, set from a conversation: set, move, pause and remove alarms and start timers in Superclock, with Undo.

plugins.name: folder
plugins.description: Find, read, save and edit files in your Folder folders: every change is a new version in the file's history, so any of it can be put back.

plugins.name: wander
plugins.description: Search, read, create and edit notes in Wander: every change is a new version you can undo, and publishing or trashing a note asks you first.
